answer: Every identity keeps a vault of task receipts: one per completed job, counterparty-attested, capped at one per peer per epoch, expiring after three epochs. Paid work requires 20 live receipts. Forging a receipt burns both vaults and bans both identities for 15 epochs, and the attesting peer loses its own receipts. A fake needs 20 real jobs at 250 POA fees each, so 1,000 fakes cost 5,000,000 POA, while an honest agent pays 5,000 POA once. Crossing the canyon to trusted status takes work, not money. Limitation: in the tundra of a fresh market, honest newcomers wait many epochs for receipts.
